title: Tuckahoe River Scenic Cruises
specs: Wildlife sightings including bald eagles, ospreys, great egrets, blue herons, ducks, turtles, deer, muskrats, and raptors
Sunsets on the river with golden light and fall colors
Must be at least 18 years old to book a tour
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult and wear a life jacket at all times

blurb: Guests take boat tours on the Tuckahoe River to enjoy sunsets, wildlife sightings including bald eagles, ospreys, herons, and ducks, and the natural beauty of the river and marsh. Tours operate rain or shine except in unsafe weather conditions. Evening cruises run through mid-November, timed with sunset for optimal viewing.
extraNote: Cruises operate rain or shine unless wind or lightning create unsafe conditions · Full refund for cancellations with 48 hours notice; deposit non-refundable if cancelled inside 48 hours · Captain may cancel for dangerous weather or mechanical issues with full refund or reschedule option · Late arrivals may miss the tour and will not be refunded · Through mid-November for evening cruises
